title: Intermittent Fasting for Working Women: Does It Fit Your Work Schedule?
intro: Intermittent fasting (IF) can suit some working women, but it is not the only way to lose weight. It only helps if it makes you eat less overall and is easy to follow.

sections.p: IF means you eat within a certain time window every day. For example 16:8, which means eating within 8 hours and not eating for 16 hours. Some also start with 12:12 or 14:10, which are more relaxed.
IF may suit you if you're really not hungry in the morning. It also helps if your main problem is night snacking after coming home from work. If your schedule is stable, it's easier to follow.

sections.h: It may not suit you if...
sections.p: If you have gastric problems, PCOS, thyroid problems, diabetes, are pregnant or have had an eating disorder before, discuss with your doctor first. Women who work shifts may also find it hard to follow a fixed eating window.
For a 9am to 6pm job, try an eating window of 11am to 7pm. Lunch at 11.30 or 12, a small snack at 3-4pm, and dinner before 7. In the morning you can have coffee or tea without sugar, and plain water.

sections.h: Within your eating window, quality still matters
sections.p: At every meal, make sure there's protein, vegetables and carbs in moderate portions. Nasi campur with one scoop of rice, chicken and vegetables is totally okay. Avoid treating the eating window as a time to eat anything without limits.

action: Start with 12:12 first, for example 8am to 8pm.
Drink a glass of plain water as soon as you wake up.
Make sure your first meal has protein like eggs, chicken or fish.
Close the kitchen after dinner and brush your teeth early.
Review after 2 weeks: do you feel more in control or hungrier?
myth: Some people believe that as long as you eat within your time window, your weight will still drop no matter what you eat. Actually, total calories still matter. IF is just a tool to help you control that total.

faq.q: Can I drink coffee in the morning while doing IF?
faq.a: Yes, coffee or tea without sugar and without milk is usually accepted. Coffee with sugar and condensed milk counts as eating. One cup of teh tarik is about 120-150 calories.

faq.q: Do I need to go straight to 16 hours?
faq.a: No need. Start with 12 hours, then increase slowly if you're comfortable. If 12 hours already helps you snack less at night, that's good enough.

faq.q: Does IF disturb the menstrual cycle?
faq.a: Every woman is different. If your period becomes irregular or you feel very tired, stop and discuss with your doctor. Don't continue if your body is giving signs that it's not comfortable.
